items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: this boy River, Elton, when he written on the country... He said oh I know a fella you might get to play in your band... So sure enough I was already down here you know... So I went on and he went right straight to his house.

ctx.x: He never played with us because he left and went away, he went to Texas you see. He left and went to Texas. But Edmund, Robert, and Clowns, all of them we played together, we come up together you see, we played together you see. So well after that all left, well quite naturally that just left me. So now. I said well, I said it's my move now you know. So what I did Mr. Bill, I met up my mind and left. That's why I came here.
